name: Crime Rhyme
source:
Aida Masaki, the leader of the newspaper club, has been investigating the rumor of ghosts with Kaede and Hinoki. Meanwhile, Shion, who lives with Masahi, is invited to the psychic treatment club's anniversary party by her classmate. However, the psychic treatment club is actually a group of rapists.

[From [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=4253]AniDB[/url]]
translation:
报社社长会田正树一直与枫和桧一起调查鬼魂传闻。与此同时，与正日住在一起的紫苑被同学邀请参加心理治疗俱乐部的周年纪念聚会。然而，心灵治疗俱乐部实际上是一群强奸犯。

[来自[url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=4253]AniDB[/url]]
